pairs: Prope est ut veniat tempus ejus,
and her days will not be prolonged.
For the Lord will take pity on Jacob,
and he will still choose from Israel,
et requiescere eos faciet super humum suam;
and he will cause them to rest upon their own soil.
And the new arrival will be joined to them,
and he will adhere to the house of Jacob.
And the people will take them,
et adducent eos in locum suum;
and lead them to their place.
et possidebit eos domus Israël super terram Domini in servos et ancillas:
And the house of Israel will possess them, in the land of the Lord, as men and women servants.
et erunt capientes eos qui se ceperant,
And they will take captive those who had taken them captive.
And they will subjugate their oppressors.
And this shall be in that day:
cum requiem dederit tibi Deus a labore tuo,
when God will have given you rest from your labor,
et a servitute dura qua ante servisti,
and from the difficult servitude under which you served before,
sumes parabolam istam contra regem Babylonis,
you will accept this parable against the king of Babylon,
“How is it that the oppressor has ceased,
The Lord has crushed the staff of the impious,
cædentem populos in indignatione plaga insanabili,
which struck the people in wrath with an incurable wound,
which subjugated the nations in fury,
All the earth has become quiet and still;
it has been gladdened and has rejoiced.
abietes quoque lætatæ sunt super te,
The evergreens, too, have rejoiced over you,
no one has ascended who would cut us down.’
Infernus subter conturbatus est in occursum adventus tui;
Hell below was stirred up to meet you at your advent;
it has awakened the giants for you.
Omnes principes terræ surrexerunt de soliis suis,
All the leaders of the earth have risen from their thrones,
all the leaders among the nations.”
Everyone will respond and will say to you:
Et tu vulneratus es sicut et nos;
Detracta est ad inferos superbia tua,
Your arrogance has been dragged down to Hell.
The moths will be strewn beneath you,
and the worms will be your covering.
How is it that you have fallen from heaven,
who used to rise like the sun?
How is it that you have fallen to the earth,
And you said in your heart:
super astra Dei exaltabo solium meum;
I will exalt my throne above the stars of God.
I will be enthroned upon the mountain of the covenant,
I will ascend above the tops of the clouds.
I will be like the Most High.’
Yet truly, you shall be dragged down to Hell,
into the depths of the pit.
Numquid iste est vir qui conturbavit terram,
saying: ‘Could this be the man who disturbed the earth,
who made the world into a desert
who would not even open a prison for his prisoners?’”
Omnes reges gentium universi dormierunt in gloria,
All the kings of the nations throughout the whole world have slept in glory,
each man in his own house.
tu autem projectus es de sepulchro tuo,
But you have been rejected from your grave,
et obvolutus cum his qui interfecti sunt gladio,
and you have been bound up with those who were slain by the sword,
and who descended to the bottom of the pit,
You will not be associated with them,
For you have destroyed your own land;
you have slain your own people.
non vocabitur in æternum semen pessimorum.
The offspring of the wicked ones will not be called upon for eternity.
Prepare his sons for the slaughter,
according to the iniquity of their fathers.
nor fill the face of the world with cities.
But I will rise up against them,
And I will perish the name of Babylon
et ponam eam in possessionem ericii,
And I will appoint it as a possession for the hedgehog,
et scopabo eam in scopa terens,
And I will sweep it out and wear it away with a brush,
The Lord of hosts has sworn,
just as I have considered it,
and in the same manner as I have drawn it through my mind,
ut conteram Assyrium in terra mea,
So shall I crush the Assyrian in my land,
et in montibus meis conculcem eum;
and I will trample him upon my mountains,
et auferetur ab eis jugum ejus,
and his yoke will be taken away from them,
et onus illius ab humero eorum tolletur.
and his burden will be removed from their shoulder.
Hoc consilium quod cogitavi super omnem terram;
This is the plan that I have decided, concerning the entire earth,
et hæc est manus extenta super universas gentes.
and this is the hand which is extended over all the nations.
For the Lord of hosts has decreed it,
and who is able to weaken it?
In anno quo mortuus est rex Achaz,
In the year in which king Ahaz died,
quoniam comminuta est virga percussoris tui;
that the rod of him who struck you has been crushed.
de radice enim colubri egredietur regulus,
For from the root of the serpent will go forth a king snake,
and his offspring will engulf that which flies.
And the firstborn of the poor will be pastured,
and the poor will rest in faithfulness.
et interire faciam in fame radicem tuam,
And I will cause your root to pass away by famine,
and I will put to death your remnant.
All of Philistia has been prostrated.
For a smoke will arrive from the north,
et non est qui effugiet agmen ejus.
and there is no one who will escape his army.
And what will be the response to this news among the nations?
It will be that the Lord has established Zion,
et in ipso sperabunt pauperes populi ejus.
and that the poor of his people will hope in him.
